title: Add a POST /api/export endpoint that converts the current edited image to PNG
body:
We need a server endpoint that accepts the current edit result from the client and returns a PNG. Acceptance criteria:

1. Endpoint: POST /api/export with JSON body { imageId: string, format: 'png' | 'jpeg', quality?: number }
2. Looks up the cached edit result by imageId.
3. Encodes it to the requested format (default png).
4. Returns the bytes with Content-Type set correctly and Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=<imageId>-edited.<ext>.
5. Returns 404 when imageId is unknown, 400 when format is unsupported.
6. Includes a node:test test file that exercises the happy path and both error paths.

This is small, bounded, and self-contained. No external services needed.
author: alice
